assessment: The source replay seed and two 30/35-tick early shifts all stop before their first forced action on the exact bundled target. This rules out those particular replay transfers and localises the immediate failure to a target route/state problem before the first command; it does not separate level-revision differences from source/native physics and does not establish impossibility or multi-skill coverage. No replay was emitted or strictly verified. Keep the level unscored.
